sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯汀·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分采访内容，供所有人免费观看。

If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: I was contacted on a Tuesday evening as I was leaving my office from someone in New York, and they said it's something big.
sentences.zh: 那是一个周二的晚上，我正要离开办公室时接到了一个来自纽约的电话，对方说有大事发生。

sentences.en: And it's funny because I think most people would expect me to say I was shocked by the call, and I really wasn't.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我想大多数人会以为我会说那个电话让我感到震惊，但其实并没有。

sentences.en: We spoke for eight hours the first time I came, and he was really interested in speaking to a female lawyer, and I said I thought that was a good idea for him.
sentences.zh: 我第一次去见他时，我们谈了八个小时。他非常想和一位女律师交谈，我说我觉得这对他是件好事。

sentences.en: Being a woman at least puts me in a position where people say, well, wait, this woman has sort of a different position than what the majority of women are feeling today.
sentences.zh: 身为女性，至少让我处于这样一个位置：人们会说，等等，这位女性的立场与当今大多数女性的感受似乎有所不同。

sentences.en: But I also believe that I hold a position that a lot of women feel and don't want to talk about.
sentences.zh: 但我也相信，我所持有的立场是许多女性心中所想却不愿说出来的。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, Harvey Weinstein is well aware of the fact that his life is on the line here.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，哈维·温斯坦非常清楚自己的余生正悬于一线。

sentences.en: And, you know, obviously having a voice is not only necessary and fair, but it's something that he deserves.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，显然拥有发言权不仅是必要和公平的，也是他应得的。

sentences.en: He deserves to have a voice out there.
sentences.zh: 他理应拥有发言权。

sentences.en: How are you feeling, Harvey?
sentences.zh: 你感觉如何，哈维？

sentences.en: Your mother's not here to see this.
sentences.zh: 你的母亲没能看到这一幕。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Harvey Weinstein walked gingerly into court this morning.
sentences.zh: 哈维·温斯坦今天早上小心翼翼地走进法庭。

sentences.en: Without the walker, he has relied on for weeks.
sentences.zh: 没有使用他几周来一直依赖的助行器。

sentences.en: In the trial of Harvey Weinstein, six women have taken the stand, each making similar accusations of rape and sexual assault against the movie producer.
sentences.zh: 在哈维·温斯坦的审判中，六名女性出庭作证，每人都对这位电影制片人提出了类似的强奸和性侵指控。

sentences.en: She alleged that Harvey Weinstein urinated on her, threw her on the bed, got on top of her.
sentences.zh: 她声称哈维·温斯坦向她撒尿，把她扔在床上，并压在她身上。

sentences.en: Today, she took the stand, recounting three separate assaults, at times sobbing uncontrollably.
sentences.zh: 今天，她出庭作证，讲述了三次独立的袭击事件，期间一度无法控制地啜泣。

sentences.en: But the defense previewed what it called dozens of loving emails sent by some accusers to the producer.
sentences.zh: 但辩方预先展示了他们所称的由一些原告发给制片人的数十封充满爱意的电子邮件。

sentences.en: Throughout their testimony, Weinstein's defense lawyers have portrayed those encounters as consensual.
sentences.zh: 在整个证词过程中，温斯坦的辩护律师一直将这些接触描述为双方自愿。

sentences.en: The relationship continued.
sentences.zh: 关系仍在继续。

sentences.en: And suggested that in many cases, it was the women who wanted something from Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 并暗示在许多情况下，是女性想要从温斯坦那里得到什么。

sentences.en: Donna Rattuno, Harvey Weinstein's lawyer, asked Jessica Mann to read an email that she had sent to her boyfriend at the time.
sentences.zh: 哈维·温斯坦的律师唐娜·拉图诺要求杰西卡·曼读出她当时发给男友的一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: His lawyers have seized on the fact that the two women whose accounts are at the center of the criminal charges
sentences.zh: 他的律师抓住了这样一个事实：两名处于刑事指控核心的女性，

sentences.en: agreed to have sex and friendly contact with Weinstein after they were allegedly victimized.
sentences.zh: 在据称受害后，仍同意与温斯坦发生性关系并保持友好往来。

sentences.en: Today, on her second day of testimony, Jessica Mann had a breakdown on the stand during cross-examination when she was being questioned by Weinstein's attorney, Donna Rattuno.
sentences.zh: 今天，在作证的第二天，杰西卡·曼在接受温斯坦的律师唐娜·拉图诺盘问时，在证人席上情绪崩溃了。

sentences.en: You met Harvey Weinstein at a Hollywood Oscar party, the defense attorney asked.
sentences.zh: 辩护律师问：你在好莱坞的一场奥斯卡派对上遇到了哈维·温斯坦。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Did you think that meant you were getting a role?
sentences.zh: 你认为这意味着你能得到一个角色吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Megan Toohey, one of the reporters who broke the story of Weinstein's
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事梅根·图伊，也就是两年多前率先报道温斯坦

sentences.en: alleged abuse more than two years ago, speaks with Donna Rattuno, the lawyer behind Weinstein's defense strategy.
sentences.zh: 涉嫌虐待事件的记者之一，将与温斯坦辩护策略背后的律师唐娜·拉图诺进行对话。

sentences.en: Morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Any comment on the problem if you want to find you?
sentences.zh: 如果你想找到我，对这个问题有什么评论吗？

sentences.en: I have a good lawyer.
sentences.zh: 我有一位好律师。

sentences.en: How you doing?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 希望如此。

sentences.en: Right now, love.
sentences.zh: 现在，亲爱的。

sentences.en: It's Friday, February 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月7日，星期五。

sentences.en: We can start.
sentences.zh: 我们可以开始了。

sentences.en: Okay, so you're going to put on your phone.
sentences.zh: 好的，你要把手机放好。

sentences.en: Do you want to tell us what you had for breakfast?
sentences.zh: 你想告诉我们你早餐吃了什么吗？

sentences.en: Sure, I had nothing for breakfast, actually.
sentences.zh: 当然，其实我没吃早餐。

sentences.en: Not even a coffee.
sentences.zh: 连咖啡都没喝。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, Donna, thank you again for being with us this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那么，唐娜，再次感谢你今天下午接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: I've read that you have represented as many as 40 men accused of sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 我读到过你曾代理过至少40名被控性不端的男性。

sentences.en: That's a lot.
sentences.zh: 那可不少。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Do you remember a specific case that pulled you in to representing men accused of sexual misconduct?
sentences.zh: 你还记得是什么特定的案件让你开始代理被控性不端的男性的吗？

sentences.en: You know, I think really one of the cases that pulled me in initially before I even was taking these kinds of cases was the Duke Lacrosse case.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想在处理这类案件之前，最初吸引我的是杜克大学长曲棍球队案。

sentences.en: It's like, you know, here we have the media coming out and just assassinating these young guys and then coming to find out that this story completely collapsed.
sentences.zh: 当时媒体出来对这些年轻人进行口诛笔伐，结果发现这个故事完全站不住脚。

sentences.en: And I remember my mother saying at the time when we were watching the coverage on the news, when those boys die someday, their obituary is going to say the Duke Lacrosse players.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时我们看新闻报道时，我母亲说，当这些男孩将来去世时，他们的讣告上会写着“杜克大学长曲棍球队员”。

sentences.en: And I thought, wow, here's this allegation that sticks with you your whole life.
sentences.zh: 我想，哇，这是一个会伴随你一生的指控。

sentences.en: I mean, these are life-changing circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些是改变人生的境遇。

sentences.en: You know, I think quite often we look to the accusers and we talk about the effects that these
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为我们经常关注原告，谈论这些事情

sentences.en: things have on their lives, but we do not look at the effects that these types of allegations and accusations have on the person being accused.
sentences.zh: 对她们生活的影响，但我们并没有关注这类指控对被指控者产生的影响。

sentences.en: And, you know, you have to look at what it does to people's financial abilities, their status and community.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你必须看看它对人们的经济能力、社会地位的影响。

sentences.en: I mean, I represented a guy in Chicago who was a custom clothing designer who made clothes for movie sets and presidents and high-level executives in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 我曾在芝加哥代理过一个人，他是一位定制服装设计师，为电影片场、总统和芝加哥的高层管理人员制作服装。

sentences.en: And one woman makes an allegation and all of that business goes away.
sentences.zh: 结果一个女人提出指控，所有的生意就都没了。

sentences.en: And so he wins.
sentences.zh: 所以他赢了。

sentences.en: But what do you win?
sentences.zh: 但你赢得了什么？

sentences.en: You win your case in criminal court and then you have to worry about building your reputation back, if you can,
sentences.zh: 你在刑事法庭上赢了官司，然后你必须担心如何重建你的声誉（如果可能的话），

sentences.en: where people are willing to then come back and frequent your establishment.
sentences.zh: 让人们愿意再次光顾你的店。

sentences.en: So the ramifications are social, they're economic, they are the mental toll that it takes.
sentences.zh: 所以后果是社会性的、经济性的，还有它带来的精神创伤。

sentences.en: I mean, look at Harvey.
sentences.zh: 看看哈维就知道了。

sentences.en: Look at Harvey physically from what he looked like when all of this started to what he looks like now.
sentences.zh: 看看哈维从这一切开始时的样子，再看看他现在的样子。

sentences.en: People can talk all they want about walkers and faking it.
sentences.zh: 人们可以随心所欲地谈论助行器和装病。

sentences.en: And physically, it is so apparently obvious what this has done and the toll this has taken on him.
sentences.zh: 但在身体上，这一切对他造成的影响和代价是显而易见的。

sentences.en: You know, you're talking about the toll that the criminal justice system can take on men accused of sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你在谈论刑事司法系统对被控性不端的男性可能造成的代价。

sentences.en: When I was working as a reporter in Chicago, my investigations turned up evidence of the opposite, that all too often victims of sex crimes were the ones being mistreated
sentences.zh: 当我在芝加哥做记者时，我的调查发现了相反的证据，即性犯罪的受害者往往才是被警察和检察官虐待的人。

sentences.en: by police and prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 我发现执法部门，例如，将强奸取证包束之高阁。

sentences.en: I discovered that law enforcement was, for example, shelving rape kits.
sentences.zh: 基本上，搁置了本可以帮助受害者伸张正义的宝贵 DNA 证据。

sentences.en: Basically, sitting on valuable DNA evidence that could help victims obtain justice.
sentences.zh: 我发现有性虐待行为的医生在病人向警方举报后仍在继续执业。

sentences.en: I found that sex abusing doctors were continuing to practice even after patients reported them to police.
sentences.zh: 针对我的报道，检察官和警察承认他们辜负了受害者。但你是在说，

sentences.en: And in response to my reporting, prosecutors and police acknowledged that they had failed victiMs. But are
sentences.zh: 从你的角度来看，是被指控者受到了不公平对待，还是……

sentences.en: you saying that from your perspective, it was the accused who were being treated unfairly or...
sentences.zh: 不，我是在谈论这样一个事实：特别是在今天，我只能告诉你，在我的案件中，我所看到的是，

sentences.en: No, I'm talking about the fact that we, especially today, all I can tell you is in my cases, what I
sentences.zh: 我们允许提出指控的人自动获得受害者身份。

sentences.en: see, we allow people who make allegations to automatically take on a victim status.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我所追求的只是公平。

sentences.en: And I think for me, all I'm looking for is fairness.
sentences.zh: 如果我们自动认为我们应该相信所有女性、相信所有受害者或相信所有站出来的人，我们就省去了

sentences.en: And if we automatically have this notion that we're supposed to believe all women or believe all victims or believe all people that come forward, we are taking out a very large
sentences.zh: 在得出“仅仅因为某人说了什么就应该被相信”这一结论之前，我们本应采取的很大一部分步骤。

sentences.en: portion of the steps that we should be taking before we get to that notion that just because someone says something, they should be believed.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，你知道，你所报道的内容，我不会反驳。

sentences.en: So I think it's, you know, what you have reported, I will not disagree with.
sentences.zh: 我见过警察做可怕的事情。

sentences.en: I've seen police do horrible things.
sentences.zh: 我见过检察官做可怕的事情。

sentences.en: I've seen prosecutors do horrible things.
sentences.zh: 但我是在谈论经历这样的事情和指控对一个人意味着什么。

sentences.en: But I'm speaking from the perspective of what I think going through something like this and an allegation does to someone.
sentences.zh: 两者并不存在谁比谁更严重的问题。

sentences.en: And one isn't more serious than the other.
sentences.zh: 两者不应该有轻重之分。

sentences.en: One shouldn't be more important than the other.
sentences.zh: 它们都是事实。

sentences.en: They're facts.
sentences.zh: 人们站出来很难。

sentences.en: Difficult for people to come forward.
sentences.zh: 人们被指控也很难。

sentences.en: Difficult for people to be accused.
sentences.zh: 你是说，当你建立自己的业务并在这个领域创造了代理被控性不端的男性这一细分市场时，

sentences.en: Are you saying that as you built your practice and created this niche in terms of representing men
sentences.zh: 在你看来，刑事司法系统偏袒受害者吗？

sentences.en: accused of sexual misconduct that, as you saw it, the criminal justice system favored victims?
sentences.zh: 我认为是百分之百。

sentences.en: I think 100 percent.
sentences.zh: 我认为是百分之百偏袒受害者。我认为今天的检察官和警察害怕对投诉证人和原告持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: I think 100 percent favor victiMs. I think prosecutors and police are afraid to be skeptical of complaining witnesses and accusers today.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们觉得“我最好还是相信他们说的话”。

sentences.en: I think they feel like I better just believe what they say.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种情况也发生在家庭暴力案件中。

sentences.en: I think it's also happening in domestic violence cases.
sentences.zh: 盘问性犯罪的所谓受害者是什么感觉？

sentences.en: What is it like to cross-examine alleged victims of sex crimes?
sentences.zh: 我认为这需要一套熟练的提问技巧和准备工作。

sentences.en: I think that it requires a skillful set of, you know, questions and preparation.
sentences.zh: 我从不认为我的工作是去那里试图表现得不尊重、辱骂某人，或者贬低她们声称发生在自己身上的事情。

sentences.en: And I don't ever look at my job as going in there trying to be disrespectful or berate someone or, you know, minimize what they claim happened to them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我并不以让人们经历她们可能觉得困难的情况为荣。

sentences.en: You know, I don't take pride in having to put people through circumstances that they may find difficult.
sentences.zh: 那不是我工作的目的。

sentences.en: That's not the point of what I do.
sentences.zh: 我的工作是提出问题，让事实裁决者（无论是法官还是陪审团）来判断他们是否认为她们的故事是可信的。

sentences.en: My job is to ask questions that make a trier of facts, whether that be a judge or a jury, determine if they think their story is credible.
sentences.zh: 某人说的话并不意味着那就是发生的事情。

sentences.en: What someone says does not mean that that's what happened.
sentences.zh: 故事总是有两面性。

sentences.en: There's always more than one side to a story.
sentences.zh: 我们的宪法中有第六修正案，即与证人对质的权利。

sentences.en: And there's something in our Constitution, the Sixth Amendment right to confront witnesses.
sentences.zh: 我的客户，无论当时是谁，都有权通过我和我的团队与他的原告对质。

sentences.en: And my client, whoever that is at the time, has the right to confront his accusers through me or my team.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这就是我必须做的。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's what I have to do.
sentences.zh: 生活在这个国家，如果不相信这一点，我感到困惑。

sentences.en: And to live in this country, to not believe that baffles me.
sentences.zh: 那么，你如何看待“我也是”（Me Too）运动的发展？

sentences.en: So what did you think about how the Me Too movement unfolded?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我谈论过很多次“我也是”运动，我被贴上了反“我也是”的标签。

sentences.en: You know, I've talked about Me Too a lot, and I get labeled this anti-Me Too.
sentences.zh: 这并不是真正的反“我也是”。

sentences.en: It's not really anti-Me Too.
sentences.zh: 这是反对因为“我也是”这类事情而产生的结果。

sentences.en: It's anti what happens because of things like Me Too.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果“我也是”带来了500个积极的结果，

sentences.en: So if 500 positives come from
sentences.zh: 我相信我可以和你坐在这里，看看“我也是”带来的所有事情，并同意它确实带来了积极的东西。

sentences.en: Me Too, and I'm sure I could sit here with you and look at all the things that have come from Me Too and agree that there's positive things that come from Me Too.
sentences.zh: 但如果作为其中的一部分，它剥夺了你的正当程序权利，如果我们要在审判前就给人们定罪，我觉得这是破坏性和有害的。

sentences.en: But if as part of that, that strips your right to due process, if we're going to convict people before they have a trial, I find that to be damaging and detrimental.
sentences.zh: 在决定代理温斯坦时，你是否考虑过温斯坦在刑事指控之外长期存在的性骚扰和性侵指控历史，

sentences.en: In making your decision to represent Weinstein, did you factor in this long history of accusations of sexual harassment and sexual assault against Weinstein outside of the
sentences.zh: 其中一些指控是在2017年“我也是”运动爆发前几年提出的？

sentences.en: criminal charges, some of which were made years before 2017 and the Me Too movement being ignited?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我没有。

sentences.en: You know, I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我没有考虑，因为我在此案中的角色是在刑事案件中代表他。

sentences.en: I didn't because my role in this is to represent him in a criminal case.
sentences.zh: 正如我多次说过的，罪孽（sins）和犯罪（crimes）是有区别的。

sentences.en: And as I've said multiple times, there's a difference between sins and crimes.
sentences.zh: 你可以认为哈维·温斯坦是一个有罪孽的人。

sentences.en: And you can believe that Harvey
sentences.zh: 你可以认为他做了一些你不会做或你不喜欢的事情。

sentences.en: Weinstein is a sinner.

sentences.zh: 我不是在辩论这些。

sentences.en: I'm merely stating that now that we're in a criminal courtroom, there is a different forum to be able to tell this story and let this, these events play out.
sentences.zh: 我只是陈述，既然我们现在在刑事法庭上，就有了一个不同的论坛来讲述这个故事，让这些事件自然发展。

sentences.en: That's all.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: So certainly there are women who believe you are doing the right thing by defending Harvey Weinstein, but you must know a lot of women who see you as a kind of traitor.
sentences.zh: 所以肯定有一些女性认为你为哈维·韦恩斯坦辩护是正确的做法，但你一定认识很多把你看作叛徒的女性。

sentences.en: How do you respond to that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何回应？

sentences.en: You know, all I can say to them is I hope they never find themselves in a situation where their
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只能对她们说，我希望她们永远不要发现自己处于这样的境地：她们的

sentences.en: family member is accused and they're hoping that the criminal justice system is fair to them,
sentences.zh: 家庭成员被指控，而她们希望刑事司法系统对他们公平，

sentences.en: because at the end of the day, that's the most important part of this whole aspect is that,
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，这一整个方面最重要的一点是，

sentences.en: you know, if you are accused of a crime, the system of justice should work one way or another.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你被指控犯罪，司法系统应该以某种方式运作。

sentences.en: And I'm not here to predict outcomes.
sentences.zh: 我不是来预测结果的。

sentences.en: I don't know what's going to happen or what the jury's going to do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道会发生什么，也不知道陪审团会做什么。

sentences.en: But just as everybody wants fairness to the people making allegations,
sentences.zh: 但就像每个人都希望对提出指控的人公平一样，

sentences.en: I want Mr. Weinstein to have the same fairness that should be afforded to him.
sentences.zh: 我也希望韦恩斯坦先生能得到应该给予他的同样的公平。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much for taking the time to talk to us, Donna.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢你抽出时间与我们交谈，唐娜。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I appreciate it, too.
sentences.zh: 我也很感激。

sentences.en: Are there any other questions, guys?
sentences.zh: 还有其他问题吗，各位？

sentences.en: I know that was a long one.
sentences.zh: 我知道刚才那个问题很长。

sentences.en: That's all right.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: Oh, and actually, I had another question, which was whether or not you've been sexually assaulted.
sentences.zh: 哦，其实我还有一个问题，就是你是否曾被性侵过。

sentences.en: I have not.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I have not.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: Because I would never put myself in that position.
sentences.zh: 因为我绝不会让自己处于那种境地。

sentences.en: So you're saying, okay, actually, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，好吧，其实，抱歉。

sentences.en: So you're saying that you have never been sexually assaulted because you would never put yourself in the position of being sexually assaulted?
sentences.zh: 所以你是说你从未被性侵过，因为你绝不会让自己处于被性侵的境地？

sentences.en: No, I've always made choices from college age on where I never drank too much.
sentences.zh: 不，我从大学时代起就一直做出选择，我从不喝太多酒。

sentences.en: I never went home with someone that I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 我从不跟我不认识的人回家。

sentences.en: I never, I just never put myself in any vulnerable circumstance ever.
sentences.zh: 我从不，我只是从不让自己处于任何脆弱的境地。

sentences.en: Do you believe that every woman who's been sexually assaulted somehow put herself in that position, whether it was having drinks or agreeing to go to a hotel room?
sentences.zh: 你是否认为每个被性侵的女性都以某种方式让自己处于那种境地，无论是喝酒还是同意去酒店房间？

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不是。

sentences.en: But just as we make smart decisions when we walk out on the street at night, I think you have to make the same decisions when you're putting yourself in circumstances with other
sentences.zh: 但就像我们在晚上走在街上时会做出明智的决定一样，我认为当你让自己处于与其他

sentences.en: people.
sentences.zh: 人在一起的境地时，你也必须做出同样的决定。

sentences.en: When we walk out at night, we look around, we make sure we have our phone.
sentences.zh: 当我们晚上走在外面时，我们会环顾四周，确保我们带着手机。

sentences.en: Some people take mace.
sentences.zh: 有些人会带防狼喷雾。

sentences.en: We take precautions.
sentences.zh: 我们会采取预防措施。

sentences.en: And all I'm saying is, is that women should take precautions.
sentences.zh: 我只是说，女性应该采取预防措施。

sentences.en: Do you think it's possible for women to take all of those precautions and still be sexually assaulted, to still be pulled into a dark alley, to still be...
sentences.zh: 你认为女性有可能采取了所有这些预防措施，却仍然被性侵，仍然被拖进黑暗的小巷，仍然被……

sentences.en: Totally different conversation.
sentences.zh: 那是完全不同的对话。

sentences.en: To still...
sentences.zh: 仍然……

sentences.en: Totally, totally...
sentences.zh: 完全，完全……

sentences.en: Being pulled into a dark alley is a totally different conversation.
sentences.zh: 被拖进黑暗的小巷是完全不同的对话。

sentences.en: So you're, you're, you are talking about sexual assault, women being sexually assaulted by somebody they know?
sentences.zh: 所以你，你，你是在谈论性侵，女性被她们认识的人性侵？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Do you think it's possible for women to be sexually assaulted by somebody that they know,
sentences.zh: 你认为女性被她们认识的人性侵是有可能的吗？

sentences.en: even if they've taken precautions?
sentences.zh: 即使她们已经采取了预防措施？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Anything's possible, Megan.
sentences.zh: 什么都有可能，梅根。

sentences.en: It's not about what's possible.
sentences.zh: 这不在于什么是有可能的。

sentences.en: It's about trying to, again, minimize the risk.
sentences.zh: 而在于再次尝试将风险降到最低。

sentences.en: If you go out on a date with someone and you go out for dinner and you go out for drinks and you know them sort of, and you know, you're, you're sort of maybe developing a
sentences.zh: 如果你和某人去约会，一起吃晚餐，一起去喝酒，你对他有一定了解，而且你知道，你们可能正在发展一段

sentences.en: relationship with them and you make a choice to go into their home at the end of the night, what do you think could potentially happen?
sentences.zh: 关系，然后在深夜选择进入对方的家中，你认为可能会发生什么？

sentences.en: And if you're not prepared for what could potentially happen, I think we're kidding ourselves.
sentences.zh: 如果你对可能发生的事情没有准备，我觉得我们是在自欺欺人。

sentences.en: And then to leave and say, I had no idea that this person would maybe try to, to, to be sexual with me or have a sexual advance, I think is naive.
sentences.zh: 然后事后离开并说，我完全没想到这个人可能会试图对我进行性骚扰或有性暗示，我觉得这太天真了。

sentences.en: I can't help but feel like you continue to place the burden of safety on, on women, on, on potential victims in general.
sentences.zh: 我忍不住觉得你一直在把安全的重担压在女性身上，压在潜在的受害者身上。

sentences.en: Should the burden rest on them or should it rest on the perpetrators?
sentences.zh: 这个重担应该由她们承担，还是应该由施暴者承担？

sentences.en: I think, I think it should rest equally.
sentences.zh: 我认为，我认为应该由双方平等承担。

sentences.en: And you know, we've moved this conversation so far away from what we were talking about, but if you go out with someone, you know, you can't have it both ways.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们已经把话题扯得太远了，但如果你和某人出去约会，你知道，你不能既要又要。

sentences.en: We can't have things like Tinder where people swipe right and go meet whoever they meet.
sentences.zh: 我们不能既有像 Tinder 这样人们向右滑动去见任何人的软件，

sentences.en: And most of the time those are sexual interactions and then say, you know what?
sentences.zh: 而且大多数时候这些都是性互动，然后又说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I went out with them and I went to their, their house and I, you know, we, you know, we were flirting or kissing or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我和他们出去了，我去了他们的家，我们，你知道，我们当时在调情或接吻什么的。

sentences.en: And then say, I had no idea that he may want to do this.
sentences.zh: 然后又说，我完全没想到他可能想做这种事。

sentences.en: You, you, you just can't have it both ways.
sentences.zh: 你，你，你就是不能既要又要。

sentences.en: So I'm saying that women need to be very clear about their intentions.
sentences.zh: 所以我说女性需要非常明确自己的意图。

sentences.en: I think women need to be very prepared for the circumstances they put themselves in.
sentences.zh: 我认为女性需要为自己所处的环境做好充分准备。

sentences.en: And I think absolutely women should take on equal risk that men are taking on and the responsibility should be equal as well.
sentences.zh: 而且我绝对认为女性应该承担与男性同等的风险，责任也应该同等。

sentences.en: Is there anything that you think that men need to do differently?
sentences.zh: 你认为男性有什么需要做出改变的地方吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I think men also need to be very clear about their intentions.
sentences.zh: 我认为男性也需要非常明确自己的意图。

sentences.en: And if I was a man in today's world, before I was engaging in sexual behavior with any woman today, I would ask them to sign a consent form.
sentences.zh: 如果我是当今世界的一名男性，在与任何女性发生性行为之前，我会要求她们签署一份同意书。

sentences.en: You are, you are being serious.
sentences.zh: 你是，你是认真的。

sentences.en: I'm being dead serious.
sentences.zh: 我是非常认真的。

sentences.en: I'm being dead serious because how easy is it for two people to engage in behavior?
sentences.zh: 我是非常认真的，因为两个人发生行为有多容易？

sentences.en: And a day later, two days later, five days later, 27 years later, somebody say, you know what?
sentences.zh: 然后一天后，两天后，五天后，27年后，有人说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: That's not what that was.
sentences.zh: 事情不是那样的。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Take all, take all of the question out of it.
sentences.zh: 把所有，把所有的问题都排除掉。

sentences.en: Make it easier on everybody.
sentences.zh: 让大家都轻松一点。

sentences.en: Well, Donna, thank, Donna, thank you again for, for taking so much time.
sentences.zh: 好的，唐娜，谢谢，唐娜，再次感谢你，感谢你抽出这么多时间。

sentences.en: I really do appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: No worries.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the prosecution rested its case against Harvey Weinstein, and defense lawyers for Weinstein began calling their own witnesses.
sentences.zh: 周四，检方结束了对哈维·温斯坦的指控陈述，温斯坦的辩护律师开始传唤他们自己的证人。

sentences.en: A Times analysis of the results of the Iowa caucuses has found that more than 100 precincts reported results that were internally inconsistent,
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》对艾奥瓦州党团会议结果的分析发现，超过 100 个选区报告的结果存在内部不一致，

sentences.en: missing data, or not mathematically possible, under the rules of the Iowa caucuses.
sentences.zh: 数据缺失，或者根据艾奥瓦州党团会议的规则在数学上是不可能的。

sentences.en: The irregularities do not appear to be deliberate and may not affect the outcome,
sentences.zh: 这些违规行为似乎并非蓄意为之，可能也不会影响最终结果，

sentences.en: but they point to larger problems with the caucuses, which have been criticized for years as amateurish,
sentences.zh: 但它们指出了党团会议存在的更大问题，多年来这些会议一直被批评为业余，

sentences.en: and raise questions about when, if ever, the public will get precise results from the conteSt.
sentences.zh: 并引发了公众何时（如果可能的话）才能从这场竞争中获得精确结果的疑问。

sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, the chairman of the Democratic National Committee, Tom Perez, called for a recount of the Iowa results.
sentences.zh: 周四下午，民主党全国委员会主席汤姆·佩雷斯呼吁对艾奥瓦州的结果进行重新计票。

sentences.zh: 这是特朗普总统在参议院弹劾审判中被判无罪后的首次公开讲话，他

sentences.zh: 庆祝了这一裁决，对自己的行为没有表示任何遗憾，并嘲笑了那些对他提出指控的民主党人。
